grammar_title: 表语从句(Predicative Clauses):主语 + 系动词(be/seem/look/sound/remain) + ____ 从句
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 1 Discover useful structures:表语从句。三类引导词:① that(不充当成分);② 连接代词/副词 what/where/why/how/who(在从句中充当成分或表疑问);③ whether/because/as if/as though。句子地道,答案唯一(看从句缺什么成分 + 句意,排除其他成立项)。铁律:that 不充当成分;what 充当主语/宾语;if 不引导表语从句(用 whether)。

points.point: that 引导表语从句(从句完整、不缺成分)
points.overview: 主语 + be/seem 等 + that 从句;that 只起连接作用、在从句中不充当任何成分,从句结构完整。常见主语:the truth/fact/problem/reason/idea/suggestion 等。

points.point: 连接代词/副词 what/where/why/how/who 引导表语从句
points.overview: 从句缺成分或表疑问时用连接词:缺主语/宾语用 what/who;问地点用 where、问原因用 why、问方式/程度用 how。这些词在从句中充当成分或状语。

points.point: whether / because / as if / as though 引导表语从句
points.overview: 表'是否'用 whether(不用 if);'……的原因是因为……'用 because;'看上去/听起来好像'用 as if / as though(与 look/seem/sound 搭配)。

questions.stem: The truth was ____ the water from the pump had been infected by waste.
questions.explanation: 从句 'the water had been infected' 结构完整、不缺成分,只起连接作用 → that。

questions.stem: The fact is ____ cholera still kills many people around the world today.
questions.explanation: 从句完整不缺成分 → that;what 须充当成分,whether 表是否,均不合。

questions.stem: Snow's finding was ____ dirty water carried the disease from house to house.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: My suggestion is ____ we collect more data before drawing any conclusion.
questions.explanation: suggestion 后表语从句用 that,从句完整且谓语用虚拟(we collect)→ that。

questions.stem: One problem was ____ the team could not agree on a single theory.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The reason for his success is ____ he never stopped asking questions.
questions.explanation: 主语已是 the reason,表语从句说明内容、从句完整 → that(不再用 why)。

questions.stem: The good news is ____ the number of cholera cases has dropped sharply.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: His belief was ____ every child starts out as a scientist.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The point is ____ Snow used maps and statistics instead of a microscope.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The idea behind the experiment is ____ a fluid can act like a solid.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: What surprised us was ____ Snow did not use any common medical tools.
questions.explanation: 表语从句 'Snow did not use ...' 完整 → that;主语处的 what 已用。

questions.stem: The trouble was ____ no institute in China then offered rocket science.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: His reply was simply ____ Chinese people could make missiles too.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The conclusion was ____ the pump in Broad Street had spread the disease.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: One of his strengths was ____ he was willing to admit his own faults.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The result was ____ water companies began to sell clean water.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: What worried the team was ____ the early experiments all failed.
questions.explanation: 表语从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: Our hope is ____ a safe vaccine will be ready within a few years.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The first sign was ____ many deaths happened near the same pump.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: The amazing thing about him was ____ art gave him ideas for his science.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: That was exactly ____ happened at the initial stage of the research.
questions.explanation: 从句 '___ happened' 缺主语 → 用 what(充当主语);that 不充当成分。

questions.stem: Science is simply ____ you can do with curiosity and evidence.
questions.explanation: 从句 'you can do ___' 缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: What John Snow showed to the world was ____ cholera could be overcome.
questions.explanation: 表语从句 'cholera could be overcome ___' 表'以何种方式被攻克' → how。

questions.stem: The question now is ____ we can reduce the cost without losing the effect.
questions.explanation: 从句不缺主宾、问'用什么方式降低成本' → how。

questions.stem: The real issue was ____ they should carry out the research in the first place.
questions.explanation: 从句不缺主宾、问'为何要做这项研究' → why。

questions.stem: A laboratory is ____ scientists test their ideas with careful experiments.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、说明'在何处' → where(表地点)。

questions.stem: That is ____ matters most to a true scientist: curiosity and creativity.
questions.explanation: 从句 '___ matters most' 缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: The key issue is ____ they communicate their results to the public.
questions.explanation: 从句不缺主宾、问方式 → how。

questions.stem: The puzzle was ____ the disease kept returning to the very same street.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、问原因 → why。

questions.stem: This museum is ____ visitors can see their own shadows in rainbow colours.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、表地点 → where。

questions.stem: Curiosity is ____ turns an ordinary child into a future scientist.
questions.explanation: 从句 '___ turns ...' 缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: The mystery was ____ some people drank the water and yet survived.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、问原因 → why。

questions.stem: A good question is often ____ a scientist begins a brand-new study.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、问方式 → how。

questions.stem: His strongest quality was ____ made him so creative: a love of art.
questions.explanation: 从句 '___ made him so creative' 缺主语 → what。

questions.stem: The lab is ____ the team spent every evening checking their results.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、表地点 → where。

questions.stem: The hard part was ____ they could persuade one another to share data.
questions.explanation: 从句不缺主宾、问方式 → how。

questions.stem: That is ____ the early scientists could not explain about the universe.
questions.explanation: 从句 'could not explain ___' 缺宾语 → what。

questions.stem: The reason behind the dispute was ____ each side wanted a different theory.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、问原因 → why。

questions.stem: The classroom is ____ I first learned to look at the world like a scientist.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、表地点 → where。

questions.stem: The final challenge is ____ they analyse the data to answer the questions.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、问方式 → how。

questions.stem: The problem was ____ the team had enough time to test every theory.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否有足够时间',表'是否'用 whether(不用 if 引导表语从句)。

questions.stem: It looked ____ all the theories were useful, but only one really was.
questions.explanation: 系动词 look + '好像' → as if / as though。

questions.stem: The only reason he switched majors was ____ China badly needed an air force.
questions.explanation: '原因是因为……',表语从句用 because 说明原因。

questions.stem: The doubt in his mind was ____ the new medicine would really be safe.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否安全',表'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: It seemed ____ the disease followed the water rather than the air.
questions.explanation: seem + '好像' → as if / as though。

questions.stem: The reason cholera spread so fast was ____ the water had been infected.
questions.explanation: '……如此快的原因是因为……' → because。

questions.stem: The first question was ____ the team should target the host or the virus.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否……或……',二选一用 whether。

questions.stem: The sky looked ____ it would rain before the field experiment ended.
questions.explanation: look + '好像' → as if。

questions.stem: The reason he is remembered is ____ he served his country with devotion.
questions.explanation: 强调'原因是因为……' → because。

questions.stem: Our worry was ____ the experiment could be repeated by other scientists.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否能被重复',表'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: It sounded ____ the two theories simply could not both be true.
questions.explanation: sound + '好像' → as if / as though。

questions.stem: The reason the handle was removed was ____ the pump kept spreading cholera.
questions.explanation: '……被卸下的原因是因为……' → because。

questions.stem: What we discussed was ____ the data really supported our first idea.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否真的支持',表'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: For a moment it felt ____ the whole project was about to fail completely.
questions.explanation: feel + '好像' → as if / as though。

questions.stem: The reason maps mattered so much was ____ they revealed a clear pattern.
questions.explanation: 强调'……重要的原因是因为……' → because。

questions.stem: The real concern was ____ a cheaper vaccine would still work well enough.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否仍然有效',表'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: It seemed ____ Hawking could see truths that others were afraid to imagine.
questions.explanation: seem + '好像' → as if / as though。

questions.stem: The reason he kept calm was ____ he trusted his solid, careful work.
questions.explanation: '……保持冷静的原因是因为……' → because。

questions.stem: The question we left unanswered was ____ the side effects could be avoided.
questions.explanation: 句意'是否能避免',表'是否' → whether。

questions.stem: At first it looked ____ targeting a protein would never beat the virus.
questions.explanation: look + '好像' → as if / as though。
